notes.title: New Bonus Chapter Available!

- A cute story about the Teacher playing fetch with Princess Pupperpants

- New soundtrack
- An ending you won't want to miss...

notes.title: Patch Notes for A Fold Apart - 2020-08-14
notes.notes: Fixed a crash caused by viewing a detailed controller layout in a Scene 1 puzzle.

notes.title: Patch Notes for A Fold Apart - 2020-07-14
notes.notes:
[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1][list][*] Puzzles can now be replayed from the Load Game menu after beating the game
[*] Diagonal folds are now easier to start with a controller[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] Fixed Spanish localizations that were using the incorrect gender[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for A Fold Apart - 2020-05-18
notes.notes:
[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1][list][*] Alternate solutions to puzzles should more reliably work
[*] Mouse controls are now more accurate and responsive
[*] Diagonal folds are now easier to start with a controller
[*] Climbing up and down blocks can now be completed much quicker
[*] There is now a significantly shorter delay after unfolding the paper before regaining control of the character, especially when unfolding them to the back of the paper
[*] Tutorials can now be closed
[*] Papers will now always rotate in the center of the screen regardless of their current size or shape[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Cameras[/h2][list][*] Puzzle cameras no longer remain active once the character leaves the puzzle[/list]
[h2]Characters[/h2][list][*] Fixed an issue with the Teacher’s arm in climbing animations
[*] Characters no longer get stuck in infinite fall loops after unfolding[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2][list][*] Fixed strings in Brazilian Portguese and Arabic that were using an incorrect quotation symbol
[*] Fixed a text message in Arabic that was left-aligned[/list]
[h2]Papers[/h2][list][*] Papers in Chapter 6 no longer clip through the camera when they rotate
[*] It is no longer possible to fold over characters
[*] It is no longer possible to solve a puzzle in such a way that the character cannot walk out of it
[*] Glowing edges will now only appear when input is allowed[/list]
[h2]Physics[/h2][list][*] It is no longer possible to create a situation where the physics of a level do not align with the visuals
[*] It is no longer possible to trigger a star while falling out of a puzzle
[*] Significantly reduced the possibility of characters and blocks falling out of puzzles when they are flipped[/list]
[h2]Pushable Blocks[/h2][list][*] Resolved a potential crash when a puzzle was unfolded with the character standing next to a pushable block
[*] Characters no longer teleport or get stuck inside blocks when rotating next to them
[*] Blocks can no longer be pushed off ledges
[*] Characters can now grab a block that has a one unit space above it[/list]
[h2]Roadblocks[/h2][list][*] Roadblocks no longer have a chance to permanently lock the Teacher after swiping at them
[*] Roadblocks no longer swipe at the Teacher every time the paper is flipped or unfolded[/list]
[h2]Tutorials[/h2][list][*] The reset puzzle tutorial is now only shown once per play session[/list]
[h2]User Interface[/h2][list][*] Continue button no longer appears unless there is an active game in progress[/list]
